Cassandra Raines

The Reborn's public leader, known as the Voice, in Compromised's Gulf Coast conflict.

Also known as: The Voice

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

The Voice of the Reborn

Raines presents herself as the Reborn's public voice and turns the Groves refinery into a symbolic target for the faction's anti-fossil-fuel campaign. [1]

Rogue betrayal

At Marsh Island, the relationship that supplied the Reborn with military material collapses violently. The novel treats Raines's death as the turning point that exposes the rogue network's manipulation. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised identifies Cassandra Raines as the public leader of the Reborn and the speaker of the group's broadcasts. [1]

  2. confirmed

    In a broadcast, Raines announces that the Reborn will target the oil refinery in Groves because the group regards continued fossil-fuel production as unacceptable. [1]

  3. confirmed

    The novel depicts Raines being fatally betrayed during the rogue arms rendezvous on Marsh Island. [1]
